data.description: You can alter your appearance at will as if using alter self. You can expend one use of mythic power to change shape as if using polymorph, with a duration of %1 [1 minute per tier]. Your caster level for this ability is a number equal to %2 [10 + your tier]. At 6th tier, the duration of the polymorph ability increases to 10 minutes per tier.|MythicManyFormsDuration|MythicManyFormsCasterLvl
